result_text:
The "Undefined Team" remainder now only collects active contributors.

**Change:** In `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`, the unmatched-contributor branch now also requires `contributor.getContributor().isActive()`. Dormant unmatched contributors are skipped and appear in no team. Configured teams are untouched, so their dormant members are still included.

Blank latest-commit dates count as active because `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` already returns true for blank input, so nobody is dropped for missing data.

**Tests:** `mvn -q -o -pl codeanalyzer test` ran with no errors reported. The module has no existing tests for team grouping, so this change is not covered by a test. I did not add one.

Nothing is committed.
